spec2def(joy.cpl joy.spec)
add_rc_deps(joy.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/applet.ico)

# joy.cpl is all Rust (joy-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/joy-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# joy.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/joy-rust/src/joy/joy.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(joy_res OBJECT joy.rc)
target_compile_definitions(joy_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(joy_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(joy joy-cargo joy.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE joy-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS joy_res uuid_sources)
